brief: Repair the jo-tu-kahegi-wahi-hoga package at the base style level after creator corrected that artifact prompts were not @a.storyof.two.

lanes.keep: The private Hinglish phrase is the hook; the story is chosen participation, not obedience.
lanes.cut: Do not turn the deck into generic patience or a literal day-in-the-life without the phrase-world.

lanes.keep: Everyday Indian couple banter, plan changes, route/food/timing decisions, and theek-hai energy.
lanes.cut: Old-school biwi-ka-hukum jokes and defeated-husband comedy.

lanes.keep: Soft Storybook Phrase-World Scenes: full Aachu/Zuv illustrated scenes with handwritten text in negative space.
lanes.cut: Artifact-first poster, register, slip, scoreboard, label, or stationery surfaces.

lanes.keep: Zuv must show visible agency on every slide; Aachu stays expressive and lovable.
lanes.cut: Bossy-wife, passive-husband, perfect-boyfriend brag, generic AI romance.

lanes.keep: Preserve the locked six lines for this repair pass.
lanes.cut: No public Aachu/Zuv names and no explanatory slide paragraphs.

lanes.condition: Run one Slide 1 style proof before scaling to all 12 final native outputs.
